name: scriptable building blocks
headline: Scriptable *building blocks*
visualData: type a name | a tile exists
* write a bee, sign it, share it | → a new verb for everyone
say: Everything is a scriptable building block. The command line is the primary interface: type a name to create, type a path to travel, and use slash commands as verbs — rewind a page, publish a website, open a game, ask an A.I. Behaviors attach to any tile, so the same tile becomes a slideshow, a website, a study deck, or a tree view depending on what you mark it with. And because behaviors are modules, the vocabulary itself is extensible: write a bee, sign it, share it — and it becomes a verb anyone can use. You're not filling in someone else's forms. You're composing your own blocks.
